title: Akbar Tu Jandi Wari Na Aakhin Sughra Nu Alwida
body:
Das Veeran, Tere Bajon, Main Keewain Jeewangi, Sun Behn Di Sada
<<DIVIDER>>
Waada Ay Bhain Da, Baahndi Sadawaangi, Tere Naal Jawangi
Menu Veeran, Karbal De, Paasay Jaan Walay
Mahmal To Na Laha
<<DIVIDER>>
Watna Te Veerna, Jay Mur Nayi Aavna, Karbal Wasaavna
Hath Chakay, Bhain Ujri, Nu Tu Daijaanvi
Marjaan Di Dua
<<DIVIDER>>
Jai Veer Tur Gaya, Menu Kaleyan Chor Kay, Haye Sanjaan Tor Ke
Marjaana, Main Veeran, Teriyan Rahwan Te
Tak Tak Ke Tere Raah
<<DIVIDER>>
Lai Jaanda Jai Kadi, Menu Naal Veerna, Wada Ay Veerna
Phuphiyan Wangu Mein Veeran, Wich Bazaaran De
Haye Jaana Be Rida
